ORCHID synthetic-papers benchmark

Three of the twenty generated documents (4–5 pages each). Each document is a short synthetic paper calculated with pycalphad from a CC BY 4.0 SGTE dataset (Hallstedt 2025). The overlay draws the truth phase boundaries (blue) over the figure, with what each deterministic baseline extracted. Not real publications; generated documents are CC BY 4.0.

Table extraction: truth vs extracted cells

Each cell shows the printed truth (top) and what the pdfplumber baseline returned at the best-aligned position (bottom, green = exact match, red = different or missing). Split tables are scored segment by segment ("Table N (continued)").
